company.name: Meticulous
company.shortDescription: Meticulous is a software testing company that develops an AI-powered automated end-to-end testing platform for web applications.
company.description:
Meticulous is a developer tools and software testing company that develops an AI-powered automated end-to-end testing platform for web applications. It enables engineering teams to generate, execute, and maintain comprehensive regression tests automatically by observing real user interactions during development. Its platform eliminates the need to manually write and maintain end-to-end tests, helping organizations ship software faster while improving application reliability.

The platform records developer and user interactions with web applications, then uses AI to generate and continuously update a deterministic suite of visual, behavioral, and functional end-to-end tests. Meticulous automatically detects regressions, mocks backend network requests to eliminate flaky tests, and integrates with continuous integration (CI) workflows and popular frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, and Svelte. It also supports GitHub, GitLab, Vercel, and other development tools, allowing teams to review the impact of code changes directly within pull requests.
